model_input:
You are an expert chess player. You are given a chess board with FEN format. Your goal is to choose a better move given two candidate moves and their strategic explanation.
The FEN of the given chess board is "8/8/p7/1p3p2/1P1k1p1p/P4K1P/5P2/8 w - - 2 47". Which move is better? MoveA:f3f4 Trade your lesser piece for a more valuable piece to gain benefit. MoveB:f3e2 Position the piece more actively, giving it greater board command. 
Answer with exactly one of: MoveA:<move> or MoveB:<move>. Only output the line, nothing else.
You MUST output an answer. If you cannot determine which move is better with confidence, output your best guess from the two candidates anyway. An answer is required; refusing to answer is not acceptable.
